verdict.rationale: Tavily is an API-first product that can be driven entirely in code. Its Python SDK takes an API key at instantiation, offers sync and async clients, and has a JavaScript SDK counterpart. It also documents programmatic rate limits with retry-after headers for production environments, and a terminal CLI (tvly search/extract/crawl/research), so it can run headlessly in automation scripts. Missing for 10: explicit CI or headless setup documentation, a documented non-interactive CLI auth path (the tvly login step opens a browser), and independent hands-on CI corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
